components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default high-priority product action; neutral rather than jade.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; color: var(--bg, #101113); background: var(--text, #F2F3F5); font: 500 13px/1.2 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background 180ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #FFFFFF; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--jade, #69E6A6); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet bordered action for secondary product tasks.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid #FFFFFF20; border-radius: 10px; color: var(--text, #F2F3F5); background: #FFFFFF06; font: 500 13px/1.2 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; transition: background 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: #FFFFFF30; background: #FFFFFF10; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--jade, #69E6A6); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Room Code Input
components.description: Compact uppercase room entry with a restrained jade focus state.
components.html: <label class="ds-code-label">Room code<input class="ds-code-input" value="DEMO" aria-label="Room code"></label>
components.css: .ds-code-label { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: var(--muted, #A8ABB2); font: 600 11px/1.4 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-code-input { width: 180px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 13px; border: 1px solid #FFFFFF18; border-radius: 9px; outline: 0; color: var(--text, #F2F3F5); background: var(--bg, #101113); font: 500 13px/1 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-code-input:focus { border-color: var(--jade, #69E6A6); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(105 230 166 / 8%); }

components.name: Primary Navigation Item
components.description: A compact shell destination with a neutral active fill and jade icon detail.
components.html: Home
components.css: .ds-nav { width: 190px; padding: 4px; background: #161719; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 10px; color: var(--muted, #A8ABB2); font: 500 13px/1 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--text, #F2F3F5); background: #FFFFFF05; } .ds-nav-item-active { color: #ECEEF2; background: #FFFFFF09; } .ds-nav-item-active svg { color: var(--jade, #69E6A6); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--jade, #69E6A6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-event-card { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line, #FFFFFF14); border-radius: 14px; color: var(--text, #F2F3F5); background: var(--surface, #191A1D); font-family: 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-event-image { display: flex; min-height: 190px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 16px; background: linear-gradient(0deg, #101113A8, transparent), #55585C; } .ds-event-image span { padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid #FFFFFF31; border-radius: 999px; background: #292C32B8; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-event-body { padding: 20px; } .ds-event-body small { color: var(--quiet, #93979F); font-size: 12px; } .ds-event-body h2 { margin: 10px 0 7px; font: 500 24px/1.15 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-event-body p { margin: 0 0 18px; color: var(--muted, #A8ABB2); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-event-body button { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid #FFFFFF20; border-radius: 10px; color: var(--text, #F2F3F5); background: #FFFFFF06; font: 500 13px/1 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-event-body button:hover { background: #FFFFFF10; } .ds-event-body button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--jade, #69E6A6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.description: Silver-sage scene glass sized so the complete setup remains visible without internal scrolling.

components.css: .ds-setup-panel { width: min(100%, 420px); padding: 22px 26px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 18%); border-radius: 27px; color: #F5F6F7; text-align: center; background: linear-gradient(140deg, #C1CBC02B, #29392F9E); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 #F0FFED38, inset 0 -1px 0 #00000025, 0 18px 50px rgb(0 0 0 / 30%); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(0.85); font-family: 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-progress { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; margin-bottom: 20px; } .ds-progress span { width: 34px; height: 3px; border-radius: 3px; background: #FFFFFF24; } .ds-progress span.is-complete { background: #B8E4C1; } .ds-setup-panel small { color: #E8EDDF; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.09em; } .ds-setup-panel h2 { margin: 12px 0 0; font: 500 32px/1.1 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.035em; } .ds-setup-panel p { margin: 12px auto 18px; max-width: 42ch; color: #E8EDDF; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-setup-panel button { width: 100%; min-height: 46px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; color: #17351F; background: #B8E4C1; font: 600 14px/1 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-setup-panel button:hover { background: #C7EACD; } .ds-setup-panel button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F5F6F7; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: Align combines a neutral, Linear-like application shell with the intimacy of a modern salon. The interface stays compact, quiet, and operational until a room image or spatial scene earns atmosphere. The approved hybrid preserves the original v1 proportions and nested containers while using the sharper v2 typography, login, header, preview, and interaction language. Reference fidelity is additive, not a license to redesign: retain the old Event two-column photo cards and compact Home, Network, and Profile composition; use the final v2 type and shell; reveal Before / During / After only after an event is opened. Silver-sage glass is inherited from the archived spatial material and belongs over imagery or inside the spatial experience.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral charcoal application layers with disciplined jade state cues.
Compact, readable 13–14px interface text and 11–12px metadata.
Opaque nested work surfaces; glass only where scene depth justifies it.
Photographic event rooms and spatial panels provide warmth without tinting the shell green.
Setup and readiness remain visible without requiring internal scrolling.

rules.name: The State Color Rule
rules.body: Jade communicates readiness, live state, a compatible reason to meet, selection, or completion. It is never decorative and never implies public ranking.

rules.name: The Neutral Base Rule
rules.body: Opaque backgrounds remain graphite or neutral charcoal; do not turn the application shell olive or dark green.

rules.name: The Compact, Not Tiny Rule
rules.body: Core support copy and controls remain 13–14px; 11–12px is limited to metadata and status labels.

rules.name: The Earned Glass Rule
rules.body: Use glass only over imagery, within the room stage, or for a short spatial overlay. Forms and long reading surfaces stay opaque.

dos: **Do** preserve the approved hybrid: v1 proportions and nested structure with v2 typography and interactions.
**Do** keep room imagery prominent while maintaining readable contrast and honest demo labels.
**Do** use silver-sage glass for spatial context and neutral opaque surfaces for product work.
**Do** keep event browsing separate from the opened-event phase preview.
**Do** keep setup content fully visible at supported viewport heights.
donts: **Don't** use dark green or olive as the base application surface.
**Don't** expand compact product pages into analytics dashboards or oversized hero layouts.
**Don't** apply glass to forms, long reading panels, or every card.
**Don't** use jade as decoration, popularity, score, or public ranking.
**Don't** invent live timing, shareability, persistence, or non-demo product claims.
